about.title: What is Simpulo?
about.intro: Simpulo matches people, not accommodation. Share a place – and find your people.
about.houses: A House on Simpulo is a shared place – a villa, an apartment, a chalet – opened by one host for two to six people, from a long weekend to a few months. The host says what the House is about: training, building, creating, slowing down. You ask to join, the host says yes, and the crew sorts out the rest together.
about.people: No hostel dorms, no strangers you never spoke to. Just people who want the same kind of trip as you.
